title: Aza'raan Historical Language Rules
status: Supplemental language specification. Proposed vocabulary and orthographic placeholders are flagged. Existing AWS files are not replaced.
source_priority: Latest user instructions in this request
Authoritative canon section of Letter Evolution Table.docx
Attached writing-system and language reference PDFs
constraints: No em dash in JSON files
One independent base letter per written cluster
Maximum two attached subscripts per independent letter
Maximum one semantic accent per atomic letter, including a subscript letter
Glottal marker precedes the host sound; click follows it
Modern B family includes b, f, v, w
No independent F, V, W, Q, X, C, or glottal/click letter in modern base alphabet
Retain every phoneme family from the authoritative letter evolution tables
Do not assign unknown Khmer code points
Keep existing AWS application assets, keyboard, and backend untouched

compatibility.reason: AWS index loads the rules view, the six-era grammar JSON and historical-dictionary.json; the actual keyboard and Apps Script backend remain unchanged.
